zh.title: 台海周邊偵獲共艦及公務船各5艘國軍監控應處
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共艦與公務船各5艘活動；國軍運用任務機艦與飛彈系統監控
body: 台灣國防部於9月4日上午發布中共解放軍台海周邊海空域動態。自9月3日上午6時至4日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲中國軍艦5艘及公務船5艘，持續在台灣海峽周邊活動。在此期間，國防部並未偵獲任何中國軍機，因此未提供相關航跡圖。
針對上述中國軍艦與公務船的持續活動，國軍運用了任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統，對周邊局勢進行嚴密監控與應處。
根據本站統計紀錄，前一次於9月1日偵獲共機2架次、共艦5艘及公務船5艘。近7日平均每日偵獲共艦6.3艘，而近30日平均則為每日7.7艘。

en.title: Taiwan Monitors 5 Chinese Warships and 5 Official Vessels Near Strait
en.summary: Taiwan detects five Chinese warships and five official vessels; military monitors the activities.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released updates on the activities of the Chinese military around the Taiwan Strait. From 6:00 a.m. on September 3 to 6:00 a.m. on September 4, 2026, authorities detected five Chinese warships and five official vessels operating continuously in the area. No Chinese military aircraft were detected during this period.
In response, Taiwan's military monitored the activities using mission aircraft, vessels, and shore-based missile systems.

According to AVWIRE database records, the previous tracking on September 1 showed two Chinese aircraft, five warships, and five official vessels. Over the past seven days, the daily average stood at 6.3 Chinese warships, compared to 7.7 warships daily over the past 30 days.
